responsibility: This file contains the small top-level backend control hooks exposed by gm2 around GCC global compilation state. In this revision most entry points are placeholders, but it is responsible for frontend-visible top-scope/backend lifecycle hooks and for toggling GCC’s flag_unit_at_a_time setting from Modula-2-facing code.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2top group: it contains the actual top-level hook definitions, including the one non-stub action that toggles flag_unit_at_a_time, whereas m2top.h only declares these hooks and m2top.def exports them to Modula-2.
